plainTranslation: A's depth and power meets B's drive. The trine lets them flow together easily.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Synced from authored synastry bundle synastry-authored__19_ (2).json.
summaryDeep:
There is a deep, powerful energy between you that flows more easily than the hard contacts.

This person activates your drive and desire in a way that tends to feel energizing rather than combative. The intensity meets your will without the constant power struggle, so you may feel strengthened by them, drawn to them physically and otherwise, capable of more with them at your side. The charge is there, but it works with you rather than against you.

When this works, you make a formidable team. You can pursue what you want with combined force, motivate each other without it becoming a contest, and bring real intensity to a shared purpose. The attraction can run deep and steady, the loyalty strong. This is the version of Mars-Pluto where the power mostly builds.

The challenge is the quieter one that comes with this much ease. Even a flowing Pluto contact runs intense, and you may take the drive for granted, or let the connection pull more of your focus and energy into its orbit than you realize. Power this comfortable can still quietly organize your life around it.

Use the energy on purpose, and keep your own footing as you do. This is the rare Mars-Pluto contact that mostly empowers rather than destabilizes. The work is channeling the intensity into what you actually want, rather than letting it run the show.
